content.notes: Review of module.py against the user contract. Empty ops returns zeros. The input is not mutated, since holds is a local dict and op fields are only read. Known gap outside the contract: unhashable id values (such as lists) raise TypeError from the dict membership test, which the contract does not address. All six test_cases.json expectations match the contract.
